title: Pork Bolognese Pasta Casserole
subtitle: with Mozzarella Cheese and Spinach

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry all produce.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add penne to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large, preferably ovenproof, pan over medium-high heat. Add pork and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, and Tuscan Heat Spice.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir marinara sauce, milk, and 1 TBSP butter into pan. Bring to a boil, then stir in as many chili flakes as you like and half the spinach (all the spinach for 4 servings). (TIP: If you want more veggies, stir in all the spinach.) Cook, stirring, until spinach wilts, 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Stir drained penne into sauce
instructions_json.body: Stir drained penne into sauce. Taste and season with salt and pepper. (TIP: If your pan isn’t ovenproof, transfer mixture to a baking dish.) Evenly sprinkle with mozzarella and panko. Top with a large drizzle of olive oil.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Bake penne mixture until panko is browned and crispy, 12-15 minutes. Divide between plates and serve.

title: Pork and Poblano Tacos
subtitle: with Kiwi Salsa and Lime Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Mince a few slices until you have 2 TBSP (3 TBSP for 4 servings). Core, deseed, and finely chop poblano. Finely dice tomato. Peel and finely dice kiwi. Roughly chop cilantro leaves and stems. Cut lime into wedges.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine sour cream and a squeeze of lime juice. Stir in water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper. In a medium bowl, toss together tomato, kiwi, minced onion, half the cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add poblano, sliced onion, and half the Mexican Spice. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly charred, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Add pork, another large drizzle of oil, and remaining Mexican Spice to pan. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until pork is browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat under pan to medium low. TIP: If there’s excess grease in your pan, carefully pour it out.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Stir in stock concentrate, ¼ cup water (⅓ cup for 4 servings), and tomato paste. Cook, stirring, until everything is coated in a thick sauce, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds. Divide pork filling, salsa, and crema between tortillas. Sprinkle with remaining cilantro. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.

title: Figgy Balsamic Pork
subtitle: with Roasted Green Beans and Rosemary Potatoes

instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry all produce. Halve, peel, and finely chop shallot. Strip rosemary leaves from stems; chop leaves until you have 2 tsp (4 tsp for 4 servings). Halve potatoes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a drizzle of olive oil, half the chopped rosemary, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Arrange cut sides down. Roast on top rack, tossing halfway through, until tender and crisped, 20-25 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat pork dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add pork and sear, turning occasionally, until browned all over, 4-8 minutes. Transfer to one side of a second baking sheet.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Toss green beans with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper on opposite side of baking sheet from pork. Roast on middle rack until pork is cooked through and green beans are tender, 10-12 minutes. Let pork rest a few minutes after removing from oven, then cut crosswise into thin slices.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in pan used for pork over medium heat. Add shallot and remaining chopped rosemary. Cook, stirring, until softened, about 1 minute. Stir in stock concentrate, vinegar, 1 TBSP jam (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and ¼ cup water (½ cup for 4). Simmer until thick and saucy, 2-3 minutes. Remove pan from heat and stir in 1 TBSP butter until melted. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide potatoes, green beans, and pork between plates. Drizzle pan sauce over pork and serve.

title: Tuscan Sausage and Pepper Spaghetti
subtitle: with Tomatoes and Parmesan

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry all produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Core, deseed, and thinly slice bell pepper. Mince parsley leaves and stems. Remove sausage from casings; discard casings.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion, bell pepper, and half the Tuscan Heat Spice. Cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add sausage and another drizzle of oil to pan. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water (1½ cups for 4 servings), then drain.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once sausage is cooked through, add diced tomatoes to pan. Season with salt, pepper, and remaining Tuscan Heat Spice. Bring to a boil, then lower heat and let simmer while spaghetti cooks. After you’ve drained spaghetti, stir stock concentrate and ¾ cup reserved pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings) into pan. Continue simmering until slightly reduced, 1-2 minutes more.

instructions_json.title: Add spaghetti to pan; toss to coat
instructions_json.body: Add spaghetti to pan; toss to coat. (For 4 servings, carefully transfer everything into pot used for pasta.) Stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4), half the parsley, and half the Parmesan. (TIP: If pasta seems dry, add more reserved pasta cooking water as needed.) Season with salt and pepper. Divide between bowls and sprinkle with remaining parsley and Parmesan.

title: Chicken Sausage & Spinach Ravioli
subtitle: Dinner’s Just 20 Minutes Away!

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry all produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Dice tomato. Quarter lemon.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add scallion whites, sausage, and Italian Seasoning. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until sausage is browned and scallions are softened, 3-5 minutes (sausage will finish cooking in step 4). Stir in tomato and cook until just softened, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, gently add ravioli to pot. Reduce to a low simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente and floating to the top, 4-5 minutes. Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water (1 cup for 4 servings), then drain. TIP: Gently shake strainer with ravioli in it to remove as much moisture as possible.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Stir stock concentrate, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a small splash of reserved pasta cooking water into pan with sausage mixture. Cook over low heat until sausage is cooked through, scraping up any browned bits from bottom of pan, 1-2 minutes. Stir in sour cream and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper. TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved cooking water a splash at a time until sauce reaches a creamy consistency.

instructions_json.title: Carefully stir ravioli into pan with sauce
instructions_json.body: Carefully stir ravioli into pan with sauce. Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice to taste.

instructions_json.title: Divide ravioli mixture between bowls
instructions_json.body: Divide ravioli mixture between bowls. Garnish with scallion greens. Serve with any remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: Italian Chicken over Lemony Spaghetti
subtitle: Lightning Prep

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry all produce. Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into ½-inch-thick pieces. Mince garlic. Zest and quarter lemon (for 4 servings, zest 1 lemon and quarter both).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta cooking water, then drain. Keep empty pot handy for use in step 5.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and softened, 4-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While zucchini cooks, pat chicken dry with paper towels and season all over with Italian Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Once zucchini is done, heat a large drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes per side. Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board to rest. Once cool enough to handle, slice chicken crosswise.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in pot used for spaghetti over medium-high heat. Add garlic, half the lemon zest, and a pinch of chili flakes. Cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30 seconds. Stir in ½ cup reserved pasta cooking water (¾ cup for 4 servings), stock concentrate, and juice from half the lemon. Simmer until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add spaghetti, zucchini, sour cream, and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) to sauce; toss to coat. Add half the Parmesan; season with salt and pepper. (TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved cooking water a splash at a time until pasta is thoroughly coated in sauce.) Divide between bowls and top with chicken. Top with remaining Parmesan and lemon zest, and a pinch of chili flakes if desired. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: Sesame Beef Tacos
subtitle: with Quick-Pickled Veggies and Chili Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Trim and slice radishes and cucumber into thin rounds. Trim and thinly slice scallions. Pick cilantro leaves from stems; discard stems.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, combine radishes, cucumber, vinegar, 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt and pepper. Taste and add a pinch more sugar if you like a sweeter pickle. Set aside, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine sour cream and a pinch of chili flakes (taste and add more from there if desired; save a little for the filling). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add scallions and cabbage; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until softened, 4-5 minutes. Add beef, garlic powder, and 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings). Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Stir in sesame oil, a pinch of chili flakes to taste, half the sriracha, and half the soy sauce. (For 4, use all the soy sauce.) Taste and season with salt, pepper, and up to ½ tsp more sugar.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While filling cooks, wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Spread a bit of crema onto each tortilla, then top with filling, a small amount of pickled veggies, cilantro, and as much remaining sriracha and chili flakes as you like. Serve with any remaining pickled veggies on the side.

title: Baked Mac ’n’ Cheese Dinner Two Ways
subtitle: Keep It Simple with Garlic Crostini + Mix It Up with Honey-Mustard Kale Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince garlic. Slice baguette crosswise into 8-10 rounds (16-20 rounds for 4 servings). Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces. Remove and discard any large stems from kale; chop into bite-size pieces.In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine minced garlic, 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4), and a pinch of salt. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and microwave until butter has melted and garlic is fragrant, 30-60 seconds. Stir and set aside (you’ll use it in Step 5).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add cavatappi to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Drain and return to pot.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While pasta cooks, in a large pan, whisk together cream sauce base and 1 cup water (2 cups for 4 servings) over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and add cream cheese, stock concentrate, and garlic powder.Cook, whisking, until cream cheese is fully incorporated and sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes.Remove from heat. Whisk in cheddar and 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4) until smooth, 1-2 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Transfer cheese sauce to pot with drained cavatappi; stir to combine. Lightly coat an 8-by-8-inch baking dish (9-by-13-inch baking dish for 4 servings) with nonstick cooking spray. Transfer mac ’n’ cheese to prepared baking dish.In a second small bowl, combine panko, 1 tsp oil (1½ tsp for 4), salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Evenly sprinkle mac ’n’ cheese with seasoned panko. TIP: Not sure if everyone loves a crunchy topping? Leave it off or just sprinkle it over half the dish. Bake on top rack until browned and crispy, 12-15 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, arrange baguette rounds on a baking sheet and brush with garlic butter. Toast on middle rack until golden brown, 5-8 minutes.Top crostini with tomato. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Place kale in a large bowl with a large drizzle of olive oil and a big pinch of salt. Using your hands, massage kale (similar to how you would knead dough) until leaves are tender, 1 minute. TIP: Don’t skip this step—massaging helps the kale leaves wilt slightly, giving them a tender (not fibrous!) texture.Add dressing; toss to combine.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Keep It Simple: Divide mac ’n’ cheese between bowls. Serve with crostini.Mix It Up: Divide mac ’n’ cheese between plates and drizzle with hot sauce to taste. Top kale salad with walnuts and serve on the side.

title: One-Pot Ravioli Bake
subtitle: with Spinach, Thyme, and Parmesan Breadcrumbs

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Preheat broiler to high or oven to 500 degrees. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Strip thyme leaves off stems (you’ll want about 1½ TBSP). Discard stems.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat 2 TBSP butter in a large ovenproof pan over medium heat. Add thyme and onions, and cook until softened, 5-6 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Add stock concentrates and 2½ cups water, and bring to a simmer.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Add ravioli to pan, cover, and cook 3-4 minutes. Uncover and increase heat to high. Spoon broth over ravioli until they're tender and broth is thickened and reduced, 5-6 minutes. If broth evaporates before ravioli are tender, add a splash of water. To keep ravioli from sticking, shake pan occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine panko, Parmesan cheese, a large drizzle of olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Remove pan from heat
instructions_json.body: Remove pan from heat. Carefully fold sour cream and spinach into ravioli until thoroughly combined with broth. Season with salt and pepper. TIP: You should have a thick, creamy sauce and wilted spinach. If the sauce is too thick, add a splash of water.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: If you're not using an ovenproof pan, transfer mixture to baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan breadcrumbs, and broil until golden brown, 2-3 minutes.

title: Hoisin-Glazed Meatballs
subtitle: with Jasmine Rice and Green Beans

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Wash and dry all produce. Peel and mince ginger until you have ½ TBSP (1 TBSP for 4 servings). Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens; mince whites.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4 servings) and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then stir in rice, cover, and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a medium bowl, combine beef, panko, minced ginger, scallion whites, garlic powder, and 2 TBSP water (3 TBSP for 4 servings). Season with salt (we used ¾ tsp; 1½ tsp for 4) and pepper. Form into 1-inch balls and place on prepared baking sheet. Bake until meatballs are browned and cooked through, 15-18 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, in a second medium bowl, combine hoisin and 2 TBSP water (3 TBSP for 4 servings). Once meatballs are cooked through, carefully transfer to bowl with hoisin mixture; toss to coat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green beans and cook, stirring, 3 minutes. Add 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4 servings) and cover pan with a lid or aluminum foil. Cook until tender, 2-3 minutes more. Uncover and let water evaporate. Season with salt and pepper.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Crispy Organic Chicken & Bacon Alfredo
subtitle: with Spinach, Parmesan & Chives

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Lightly oil a baking sheet. Wash and dry produce.Mince chives.Place 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave until melted, 30 seconds. Stir in panko, half the garlic powder (you’ll use the rest later), and a large drizzle of oil. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Place on prepared baking sheet. Evenly spread a thin layer of sour cream onto tops of chicken (you may have some left over). Mound coated sides with panko mixture, pressing to adhere (no need to coat the undersides).Roast on middle rack until crust is golden brown and chicken is cooked through, 18-22 minutes.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Once water is boiling, add spaghetti to pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes.Reserve 1½ cups pasta cooking water (2 cups for 4 servings), then drain. (Keep empty pot handy for Step 5.)

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a large dry pan over medium-high heat. Add bacon*; cook, turning occasionally and adjusting heat if browning too quickly, until crispy, 6-10 minutes.Turn off heat; transfer bacon to a paper-towel-lined plate. Once cool enough to handle, chop into small pieces.Let pan with bacon fat cool slightly, then carefully add spinach. (TIP: Allowing the pan to cool will help prevent splattering.) Cook over medium heat, stirring, until wilted, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once pasta and bacon are done, return empty pot used for pasta to stovetop over medium heat. Add cheese roux, remaining garlic powder and 1 cup reserved pasta cooking water (1½ cups for 4); whisk to combine. Cook, whisking, until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes.Reduce heat to medium low and whisk in cream cheese until melted and combined.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Add drained spaghetti, Parmesan, half the chives, and 2 TBSP butter (3 TBSP for 4 servings) to pot with Alfredo sauce. Cook, stirring, until butter has melted and pasta is coated in a creamy sauce.Stir in bacon and spinach. (TIP: If needed, stir in more reserved pasta cooking water a splash at a time.) Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instructions_json.title: Divide pasta between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide pasta between plates. Top with chicken. Garnish with remaining chives and serve.

title: Fajita Organic Chicken & Cannellini Beans
subtitle: with Roasted Zucchini & Chipotle-Peach Pan Sauce

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons. Peel and mince or grate garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss zucchini on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper.Roast on top rack until tender and lightly browned, 14-16 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While zucchini roasts, heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add garlic and half the Fajita Spice Blend (you’ll use the rest in next step); cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 30 seconds. Stir in beans and their liquid, stock concentrate, a pinch of salt, and pepper.Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer. Cook, mashing about half the beans with the back of a wooden spoon or a potato masher, until creamy and thickened, 3-5 minutes.Remove from heat; stir in crème fraîche. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.Cover to keep warm until ready to serve.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with remaining Fajita Spice Blend, salt, and pepper.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook until browned and cooked through, 5-7 minutes per side.Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board and tent with foil to keep warm.Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board and tent with foil to keep warm.

instructions_json.title: Heat pan used for chicken over medium heat
instructions_json.body: Heat pan used for chicken over medium heat. Add jam, chipotle puree, ¼ cup water, and ½ TBSP butter (½ cup water and 1 TBSP butter for 4 servings); cook, stirring, until butter has melted and sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes.Remove from heat.

instructions_json.title: Slice chicken crosswise
instructions_json.body: Slice chicken crosswise.Divide beans between shallow bowls. Top with chicken and roasted zucchini. Spoon pan sauce over chicken and serve.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Cook protein in the Air Fryer at 390°F for 9-12 minutes until cooked through and caramelized.

title: Fajita-Spiced Chicken & Bulgur Bowls
subtitle: with Tomato, Pickled Jalapeño & Garlic Lime Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Peel and mince or grate garlic; reserve a pinch in a small bowl (you’ll use it in Step 5). Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Thinly slice jalapeño into rounds, removing ribs and seeds for less heat; mince a few rounds until you have 1 tsp (2 tsp for 4 servings). Zest and quarter lime. Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a small pot over medium heat. Add scallion whites, remaining garlic, and ½ tsp Fajita Spice Blend (1 tsp for 4 servings). Cook, stirring, until softened and fragrant, 2-3 minutes.Add bulgur, stock concentrates, 1 cup water (2 cups for 4), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until water is absorbed and bulgur is tender, 12-15 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine sliced jalapeño, juice from half the lime, ¼ tsp sugar (½ tsp for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt.Cover with plastic wrap and microwave for 30 seconds. Set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally.

instructions_json.title: Pat pork* dry with paper towels
instructions_json.body: Pat pork* dry with paper towels. Season all over with remaining Fajita Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork and cook until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side.Transfer to a cutting board to rest.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To bowl with reserved garlic, add mayonnaise, sour cream, a squeeze of lime juice (two squeezes for 4 servings), a big pinch of lime zest, and a pinch of minced jalapeño to taste. TIP: If you like some zesty heat, add a small splash of jalapeño pickling liquid in place of, or in addition to, lime juice.Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Fluff bulgur with a fork
instructions_json.body: Fluff bulgur with a fork. Stir in tomato, half the scallion greens, remaining lime zest, a squeeze of lime juice, and as much remaining minced jalapeño as you like. Season with salt and pepper.Thinly slice pork crosswise.Divide bulgur between shallow bowls; top with pork. Drizzle everything with crema; garnish with remaining scallion greens and as much pickled jalapeño (draining first) as you like. Serve.

title: Salsa Macha Rice Bowls with Organic Chicken
subtitle: with Fajita Veggies & Crema

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Roughly chop peanuts. Halve, core, and thinly slice green pepper into strips. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion. Roughly chop cilantro.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer.Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, in a small, preferably nonstick, pan, add 3 TBSP oil (6 TBSP for 4 servings), 2 tsp Fajita Spice Blend (4 tsp for 4; be sure to measure—we sent more!), peanuts, sesame seeds, 1/2 tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4), and vinegar. (Mix off heat!) Stir until combined.

instructions_json.title: Heat pan with salsa macha over medium heat
instructions_json.body: Heat pan with salsa macha over medium heat. Once oil is hot and mixture begins to fry, cook, stirring constantly, until sesame seeds, peanuts, and spices are toasted, 3-4 minutes.Remove pan from heat and set aside. (TIP: Keep an eye on the mixture! If toasting too quickly, remove pan from heat and transfer mixture to a bowl.)

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper and onion and lightly season with salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies begin to soften, 2-3 minutes.Stir in half the Mexican Spice Blend (you’ll use the rest in the next step); cook, stirring, until veggies are lightly browned, 1-2 minutes more. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Pat organic chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with remaining Mexican Spice Blend and salt. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over medium-high heat. Add organic chicken; cook until browned and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. (TIP: If chicken is browning too quickly, reduce heat to medium.) Transfer to a cutting board.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, place sour cream in a small bowl. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt. Fluff rice with a fork. Thinly slice organic chicken crosswise. Divide rice between bowls. Top with organic chicken and fajita veggies in separate sections; drizzle everything with crema and as much salsa macha as you like. (TIP: Refrigerate any extra salsa macha in an airtight container for up to 3 days.) Garnish with cilantro and hot sauce to taste. Serve.

title: Fajita-Spiced Organic Chicken & Farro Bowls
subtitle: Balances protein and fiber while limiting fat, sodium, and added sugar

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a medium pot (large pot for 4 servings), combine farro, 3½ cups water (6 cups for 4), and a big pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook until farro is tender, 25-30 minutes. TIP: If you end up with any excess water, simply pour it out. Alternatively, if water evaporates before farro is done, add a splash of water.

instructions_json.title: While farro cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While farro cooks, wash and dry produce. Dice tomato into ¼-inch pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions. Finely chop cilantro. Zest and quarter lime. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine tomato, scallions, half the cilantro, half the garlic powder (you’ll use the rest later), and juice from half the lime. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside until ready to use.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Once hot, add bell pepper and onion; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and slightly softened, 3-5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat chicken* dry with paper towels. To pan with veggies, add chicken, Fajita Spice Blend, remaining garlic powder, and ¼ cup water (½ cup for 4 servings). Cook, stirring and scraping up any browned bits from bottom of pan, until chicken is cooked through, 5-7 minutes more. Taste and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In a second small bowl, whisk together sour cream and 1 tsp water (2 tsp for 4 servings). Once farro is done, stir in lime zest, remaining cilantro, a large drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Divide farro between bowls. Top with chicken, veggies, and pico de gallo. Dollop with guacamole and drizzle with sour cream. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side. title: Southwest Beef, Corn & Zucchini Flautas

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with oil. Wash and dry produce. Trim zucchini and grate on the largest holes of a box grater. Place in the center of a clean kitchen towel. Gather into a tight bundle and squeeze over the sink to remove as much liquid as possible.Drain corn, then pat dry with paper towels. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

Once corn and zucchini filling is done, add a heaping ¼ cup filling to one side of each tortilla. title: Southwest Organic Beef, Corn & Zucchini Flautas
subtitle: with Enchilada Sauce & Queso Blanco

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with oil. Wash and dry produce. Trim zucchini and grate on the largest holes of a box grater. Place in the center of a clean kitchen towel. Gather into a tight bundle and squeeze over the sink to remove as much liquid as possible.Drain corn, then pat dry with paper towels. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beef* or organic beef*; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and softened, 3-4 minutes. Add corn and scallion whites; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and lightly charred in spots, 2-4 minutes. TIP: Cover pan if corn starts to pop. Add Southwest Spice Blend and half the enchilada sauce; cook, stirring often, until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; stir in Monterey Jack until melted. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. Use pan used for beef here. Once scallion whites are charred, return beef or organic ground beef to pan and cook through the rest of this step as instructed.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, drizzle tortillas with 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings); brush or rub to completely coat on both sides.Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Once corn and zucchini filling is done, add a heaping ¼ cup filling to one side of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create flautas.Place flautas, seam sides down, on prepared sheet. TIP: Arrange your flautas snug on the sheet to keep them from unrolling.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Bake flautas on top rack until golden brown and crispy, 8-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Place remaining enchilada sauce in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave until warmed through, 45-60 seconds.In a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine queso blanco with 1 TBSP water (2 TBSP for 4 servings); microwave until warmed through, 25 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Divide flautas between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide flautas between plates. Drizzle with queso blanco and as much remaining enchilada sauce as you like. Sprinkle with scallion greens and serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 1

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a ⅓-inch layer of oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat. (TIP: Fry in batches if necessary; lower heat if chicken begins to brown too quickly.) Transfer chicken to a paper-towel-lined plate. instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), stock concentrate, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat a low simmer. Cook, covered, until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Pat steak* dry with paper towels; thinly slice against the grain. In a medium bowl, combine steak, half the Fajita Spice Blend, ½ tsp salt (1 tsp for 4 servings), and pepper. Set aside until ready to use.Wash and dry produce.Drain corn and pat dry with paper towels. Quarter lime. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Mince whites. Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over high heat. Add corn and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and lightly charred in spots, 4-6 minutes. TIP: Cover pan with a lid if kernels start to pop.Turn off heat; transfer corn to a second medium bowl and add tomato, scallion whites, and juice from half the lime (whole lime for 4 servings). Stir to combine. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.Set salsa aside until ready to use. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While corn cooks, heat a drizzle of oil in a second small pot over medium heat. Add beans and their liquid, remaining Fajita Spice Blend, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally and smashing beans slightly with the back of a wooden spoon, until warmed through, 4-6 minutes.Remove from heat, cover, and set aside until ready to serve. TIP: Beans will thicken as they sit.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for corn over high heat. Add steak and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned all over, 2-4 minutes. TIP: Steak will cook a bit more in the quesadillas, so we cooked it to medium rare.Turn off heat; transfer to a plate. Wash and dry pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface; evenly top one half of each tortilla with Mexican cheese blend. Top with steak, then fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas.Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for steak over medium heat. Add quesadillas and cook until tortillas are golden brown and cheese melts, 2-4 minutes per side (work in batches for 4 servings). TIP: Lower heat if tortillas are browning too quickly.

instructions_json.title: Step 7
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Divide corn salsa between small bowls. Cut quesadillas into thirds.Divide quesadillas, rice, and beans between plates in separate sections. Top quesadillas with guacamole, sour cream, scallion greens, and as much hot sauce as you like. Serve with corn salsa and remaining lime wedges on the side.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium pot, combine beans and their liquid, Southwest Spice Blend, 1 TBSP butter, salt (we used ¼ tsp; ½ tsp for 4 servings), and pepper. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then immediately reduce heat to medium.Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes, then mash beans with a potato masher or fork until mostly smooth. Continue simmering until mixture has thickened, 3-5 minutes more.Turn off heat; cover to keep warm.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add green pepper, salt, and pepper. title: Tex-Mex Black Bean & Cheese Quesadillas
subtitle: A meal easily customized for every type of eater

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Dice tomatoes into ½-inch pieces; divide between two small bowls. Halve lime. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; finely chop a few slices until you have 1 TBSP (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Roughly chop cilantro. Mince jalapeño, removing ribs and seeds for less heat. Drain and rinse beans.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: To one bowl with tomatoes, stir in juice from half the lime and a pinch of salt. To second bowl with tomatoes, stir in chopped onion, cilantro, juice from remaining lime, a pinch of salt, and as much jalapeño as you like. Set salsas aside, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sliced onion and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-4 minutes. Add beans and Tex-Mex paste; cook, stirring and scraping bottom of pan constantly, until warmed through, 2-5 minutes more (if a crust begins to form at bottom of pan, add splashes of water to help loosen it up; repeat as needed). Taste and season with salt or pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Place tortillas on a clean work surface
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Sprinkle half of each tortilla with one-quarter of the Mexican cheese blend; top with bean filling and sprinkle with remaining Mexican cheese blend. Fold tortillas in half to create quesadillas. Wash and dry pan used for beans.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat ½ TBSP butter (1 TBSP for 4 servings) and a drizzle of oil in pan used for beans over medium heat. Add quesadillas and cook until golden brown on one side, 1-2 minutes. Add another ½ TBSP butter (1 TBSP for 4) and flip; cook until golden brown and cheese melts, 1-2 minutes more. TIP: Depending on the size of your pan, you may need to work in batches, adding more butter and oil for each batch. Transfer quesadillas to a cutting board.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Cut quesadillas into wedges and divide between plates. For Adult Plate: Top with jalapeño salsa and as much hot sauce as you like. Snip a corner of one sour cream packet and drizzle over top. Serve. For Kid Plate: Top with plain salsa and serve with remaining sour cream on the side for dipping if desired.

title: Mexican-Inspired Chipotle Shrimp Quesadillas
subtitle: with Corn Tortillas, Pickled Cabbage & Creamy Chipotle Salsa

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and finely dice onion. Roughly chop cilantro. Quarter lime. In a small bowl, reserve ¼ cup onion (½ cup for 4 servings) for Step 4.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine cabbage, vinegar, ½ tsp sugar (1 tsp for 4 servings), salt, and pepper. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave until cabbage is slightly wilted, 1-2 minutes. Carefully remove and discard plastic wrap; set cabbage aside to pickle, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Pat shrimp* dry with paper towels; dice into ½-inch pieces. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add shrimp, remaining onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened and chicken is browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Stir in half the chipotle puree and a splash of water; cook, stirring, until sauce has thickened and shrimp is coated, 30-60 seconds more. Turn off heat; transfer shrimp to a plate. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While shrimp cooks, to bowl with reserved onion, add cilantro, salt, and pepper; stir to combine. Set aside until ready to serve. In a second small bowl, combine sour cream, mayonnaise, remaining chipotle puree, and a squeeze of lime juice (big squeeze for 4 servings). Season with salt and pepper. Set relish and salsa aside until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Wrap tortillas in very damp paper towels; microwave for 1 minute. Let rest for 1 minute wrapped in paper towels. TIP: This will make it easier to fold your tortillas without tearing them. Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Evenly sprinkle one half of each tortilla with Mexican cheese blend; top with shrimp mixture. Fold in half to create quesadillas.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for chicken over medium heat. Working in batches, add quesadillas. Cook until tortillas are crisped and cheese melts, 1-2 minutes per side. (Add more oil between batches if necessary.)

instructions_json.title: Divide quesadillas between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide quesadillas between plates. Top with salsa and relish. Serve with pickled cabbage (draining first) and remaining lime wedges on the side. TIP: Enjoy the cabbage on top of the quesadillas for a tangy bite!

title: Shallot-Sherry Butter over Bavette Steak
subtitle: plus Garlic Fingerling Potatoes & Roasted Asparagus

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust racks to middle and top positions and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Halve potatoes lengthwise. Trim and discard woody bottom ends from asparagus. Halve, peel, and mince shallot. Mince chives. Cut 4 TBSP butter into 8 pieces (for 4 servings, cut 8 TBSP butter into 16 pieces). Place in a small bowl and refrigerate until ready to use in Step 6.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, half the garlic powder (you’ll use the rest in the next step), salt, and pepper. Roast on middle rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes. Meanwhile, using kitchen shears, cut along underside of each lobster shell*, leaving meat intact and stopping at tail. Pull sides of shell apart to expose meat (do not remove meat from shell).

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Cut two 10-inch-long pieces of foil (four pieces for 4 servings). Set one lobster tail in the center of each piece of foil, cut sides facing up. Sprinkle with remaining garlic powder and top each with ½ TBSP butter. Season with salt and pepper. Wrap foil up and around lobsters, pinching to tightly seal. Place on one side of a second baking sheet.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Place asparagus on opposite side of sheet from lobster. Toss with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack until lobster is tender and cooked through and asparagus is tender and lightly browned, 10-12 minutes. TIP: Carefully open the foil packet to check that lobster is fully cooked! The shell and meat should be red. If lobster needs more time, reseal and return lobster to oven until fully cooked.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat steak* dry with paper towels; season generously all over with salt and pepper. Heat a large drizzle of oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook until browned and cooked to desired doneness, 3-6 minutes per side. Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board to rest at least 5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine shallot, vinegar, demi-glace, ½ tsp thyme, and ½ cup water (1 tsp thyme and 1 cup water for 4 servings). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium high, whisking occasionally, until reduced to about 2 TBSP (4 TBSP for 4), 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat. Whisk in reserved butter one piece at a time until sauce is creamy. TIP: Return pot to low heat to melt butter. Whisk in crème fraîche. Stir in half the chives.

instructions_json.title: Thinly slice steak against the grain
instructions_json.body: Thinly slice steak against the grain. Carefully remove lobster from foil; discard foil. Using a chef’s knife, halve lobster tails lengthwise. TIP: If you don't have a chef’s knife, use a large, sharp knife. Divide potatoes, asparagus, steak, and lobster between plates. Spoon shallot-sherry butter sauce over lobster and steak. Garnish everything with remaining chives and serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 5

Add steak; cook to desired doneness, 3-6 minutes per side for medium-rare. Turn off heat; transfer steak to a plate and dollop each piece with garlic herb butter. Wipe out pan. appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

title: Steak & Roasted Garlic Rosemary Butter
subtitle: with Mashed Sweet Potatoes & Spinach Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Cut 6 TBSP butter (12 TBSP for 4 servings) into ½-inch pieces; place in a medium bowl and bring to room temperature. Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry produce. Strip rosemary leaves from stems; finely chop leaves until you have 1 tsp (2 tsp for 4). Peel garlic. Place rosemary and garlic in the center of a small piece of foil; drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Cinch into a packet and place on a baking sheet. Roast on top rack until garlic is softened, 12-15 minutes.Meanwhile, dice sweet potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Peel and finely chop half the shallot (whole shallot for 4). Finely chop chives.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: While garlic roasts, place sweet potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes. Reserve ½ cup sweet potato cooking liquid, then drain and return sweet potatoes to pot.Mash sweet potatoes with crème fraîche and 1 TBSP butter, adding splashes of reserved sweet potato cooking liquid, until smooth and creamy. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.air_fryer: Air Fryer Adaptation: Toss coated veggies/potatoes in the Air Fryer basket at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway through until golden and crisp.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While sweet potatoes cook, in a large bowl, whisk together vinegar, shallot, half the mustard (you’ll use the rest later), 2 TBSP olive oil, ¼ tsp sugar, salt, and pepper (4 TBSP olive oil and ½ tsp sugar for 4 servings). Set aside.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once garlic and rosemary are done roasting, transfer to bowl with softened butter. Mash with a fork until garlic is incorporated and butter is mostly smooth.Stir in chives, remaining mustard, and a pinch of salt and pepper until combined.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Lay a piece of plastic wrap on a work surface. Transfer garlic rosemary butter to bottom third of plastic wrap. (For 4 servings, divide between two pieces of plastic wrap.) Spread into a 6-by-1-inch rectangle (two rectangles for 4), leaving at least a 2-inch border all the way around.With long end of butter rectangle facing you, lift up corners of plastic wrap closest to you and slowly push up and then away so butter folds onto itself. Holding ends of plastic wrap, gently roll butter back and forth on work surface, forming a log (make sure you don’t spiral the plastic wrap into the butter). Twist plastic-wrap ends to seal.Place butter in freezer until firm but sliceable, 10-15 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat steak* dry with paper towels and season generously all over with salt and pepper.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook to desired doneness, 4-7 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board; tent with foil and let rest 4-5 minutes.

instructions_json.title: While steak rests, roughly chop walnuts
instructions_json.body: While steak rests, roughly chop walnuts. Add walnuts and spinach to bowl with vinaigrette; toss to coat.Unwrap garlic rosemary butter. Slice into 6 even pieces (12 pieces for 4 servings).Thinly slice steak against the grain.Divide salad, mashed sweet potatoes, and steak between plates. Sprinkle salad with dried cherries and top steak with 1-2 slices garlic rosemary butter. TIP: Store remaining garlic rosemary butter in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 7 days.

title: Creamy Italian Chicken Sausage Gnocchi
subtitle: Enjoy a head start with prepped ingredients

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan (large high-sided pan or pot for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add sausage* and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: To pan with sausage, add gnocchi, marinara, and ¾ cup water (1¼ cups for 4 servings); stir until thoroughly combined. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi are tender and sauce has thickened, 4-6 minutes. TIP: Be sure to occasionally scrape the bottom of the pan to ensure gnocchi don’t stick.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: While gnocchi cook, empty contents of salad kit into a large bowl. Drizzle with as much dressing as you like; toss to combine. TIP: Want to save a bowl? Shake the salad, toppings, and dressing right in the bag!

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Once gnocchi are done, turn off heat; stir cream cheese into pan. TIP: If mixture seems dry, add splashes of water until desired consistency is reached. Divide gnocchi between shallow bowls; top with as much cheesy Italian crunch as you like and serve with salad on the side.

Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces.Place peppercorns in a zip-close bag; crush with a rolling pin or heavy-bottomed pan.

instructions_json.title: Once water is boiling, add gnocchi to pot

Once butter has melted, add remaining garlic and 1 tsp crushed peppercorns (2 tsp for 4), swirling and stirring occasionally until fragrant, about 1 minute.Add gnocchi, cream sauce base, ½ cup reserved pasta water (¾ cup for 4), half the Parmesan, and a pinch of salt. title: One-Pan Cheesy Beef Tacos
subtitle: with Black Beans, Poblano & Smoky Red Pepper Crema

instructions_json.title: • Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: • Wash and dry produce. • Halve, deseed, and thinly slice poblano crosswise into strips. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beef and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: • Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add poblano and cook, stirring, until softened, 5-6 minutes. TIP: If needed, add a splash of water to help poblano soften. Add poblano to pan with beef (skip the oil); cook through step as instructed.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: • While poblano cooks, drain and rinse beans. • Once poblano is softened, stir in scallion whites and 2 tsp Southwest Spice (4 tsp for 4 servings; be sure to measure—we sent more.) Cook until fragrant, 30 seconds. • Add beans, Tex-Mex paste, and 1⁄4 cup water (1⁄3 cup for 4). Cook, stirring, until filling has combined and thickened, 2-3 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: • Sprinkle bean filling with cheddar and Mexican cheese blend. Cover pan until cheese melts, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat. • Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, 30 seconds. • Divide tortillas between plates and fill with bean filling, smoky red pepper crema, and scallion greens. Serve.

title: Steak & Mushroom Crispy Rice
subtitle: with Bok Choy, Garlicky Soy Sauce, Pickled Carrots & Fried Onions

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: In a small pot, combine rice, 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4 servings), and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to use in Step 5.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: While rice cooks, wash and dry produce. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Trim and thinly slice mushrooms (skip if your mushrooms are pre-sliced!). Pat sirloin steak dry with paper towels; season generously with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a medium microwave-safe bowl, combine carrots, scallion whites, vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, and ¼ tsp salt (2 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt for 4 servings). Microwave 45 seconds. Set aside.In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, garlic powder, and 1½ TBSP sugar (3 TBSP for 4).In a separate small bowl, combine Sriracha and mayonnaise. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium, preferably nonstick, pan (large pan for 4 servings) over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, 5-7 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp soy sauce mixture (4 tsp for 4), salt, and pepper. Turn off heat; transfer to one side of a plate. Wipe out pan. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for mushrooms over medium-high heat. Add bok choy and napa cabbage and cook, stirring, until browned and tender, 4-5 minutes. Turn off heat; stir in 1 tsp soy sauce mixture. Transfer to empty side of plate; wipe out pan. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook to desired doneness, 3-6 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board and let rest 5 minutes, then thinly slice against the grain. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Once rice is done, heat a large drizzle of oil in pan used for veggies over high heat. Once oil is very hot and almost smoking, add cooked rice; spread out in an even layer. Cook, undisturbed, until a crust forms on the bottom of rice, 1-2 minutes. TIP: Oil may splatter a bit—be careful! Remove pan from heat and pour remaining soy sauce mixture over top.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: In pan, top crispy rice with steak, mushrooms, bok choy and napa cabbage, and pickled carrots (draining first) in separate sections. Garnish with scallion greens and crispy fried onions. Drizzle spicy mayo on top, and serve directly from pan.

Using a peeler, shave carrots lengthwise into ribbons, rotating as you go, until you get to the core; discard core. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Peel and mince ginger and garlic.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: In a small bowl, combine scallion whites, vinegar, and a pinch of salt. Set aside to pickle, stirring occasionally, until ready to serve.In a separate small bowl, combine sesame oil, half the soy sauce (you’ll use the rest later), 1 TBSP sugar (2 TBSP for 4 servings), and up to half the Sriracha to taste. Stir until sugar has dissolved.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large, preferably nonstick, pan over medium-high heat. Add carrots; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside.Add another drizzle of oil to pan. Add zucchini; season with salt and pepper. Cook until browned and tender, 3-5 minutes per side. Remove from pan and set aside with carrots.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in same pan over medium-high heat. Add shrimp, ginger, and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Add remaining soy sauce and cook, stirring, until liquid has mostly evaporated, 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork and season with salt and pepper; divide between bowls. Arrange shrimp, carrots, and zucchini in separate sections on top. Top with pickled scallion whites (and pickling liquid). Drizzle with sauce and remaining Sriracha to taste. Sprinkle with scallion greens and serve.

title: Southwest Chicken, Corn & Zucchini Flautas
subtitle: with Enchilada Sauce & Queso Blanco

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to top position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with oil. Wash and dry produce. Trim zucchini and grate on the largest holes of a box grater. Place in the center of a clean kitchen towel. Gather into a tight bundle and squeeze over the sink to remove as much liquid as possible.Drain corn, then pat dry with paper towels. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add zucchini and a pinch of salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and softened, 3-4 minutes. Add corn and scallion whites; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and lightly charred in spots, 2-4 minutes. TIP: Cover pan if corn starts to pop. Add Southwest Spice Blend and half the enchilada sauce; cook, stirring often, until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Turn off heat; stir in Monterey Jack until melted. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, drizzle tortillas with 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings); brush or rub to completely coat on both sides.Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Once corn and zucchini filling is done, add a heaping ¼ cup filling to one side of each tortilla. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create flautas.Place flautas, seam sides down, on prepared sheet. TIP: Arrange your flautas snug on the sheet to keep them from unrolling.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Bake flautas on top rack until golden brown and crispy, 8-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Place remaining enchilada sauce in a small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave until warmed through, 45-60 seconds.In a second small microwave-safe bowl, combine queso blanco with 1 TBSP water (2 TBSP for 4 servings); microwave until warmed through, 25 seconds.

instructions_json.title: Divide flautas between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide flautas between plates. Drizzle with queso blanco and as much remaining enchilada sauce as you like. Sprinkle with scallion greens and serve.

title: Flautas Supreme with Organic Beef
subtitle: with Pico de Gallo & Smoky Red Pepper Crema

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil and brush with oil (or coat with nonstick spray). Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; mince a few slices until you have 1 TBSP (2 TBSP for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sliced onion; cook for 3 minutes.Add beef* and Southwest Spice Blend; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until beef is browned and onion is softened, 4-6 minutes. Stir in Tex-Mex paste and ⅓ cup water (½ cup for 4 servings). Simmer until thickened and beef is cooked through, 2-4 minutes more. Turn off heat.Stir in Tex-Mex paste and ⅓ cup water (½ cup for 4 servings). Simmer until mixture has thickened and beef is cooked through, 2-4 minutes more. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, drizzle tortillas with 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings); brush or rub to completely coat.Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Once beef filling is done, add a heaping ¼ cup filling to one side of each tortilla, then sprinkle each with 1 TBSP Mexican cheese blend. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create flautas. Place, seam sides down, on prepared sheet. TIP: Make sure the flautas are snug on the sheet—this will prevent them from unrolling.Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crispy, 8-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: While flautas bake, finely dice tomato
instructions_json.body: While flautas bake, finely dice tomato. In a small bowl, combine tomato and minced onion. Season with salt.Divide flautas between plates. Top with pico de gallo and red pepper crema. Serve.

title: Air Fryer Beef, Black Bean & Potato Flautas
subtitle: with Mexican Cheese, Black Beans & Fresh Tomato Salsa

instructions_json.title: Preheat air fryer to 375 degrees
instructions_json.body: Preheat air fryer to 375 degrees. Wash and dry produce.Drain and rinse beans. Roughly chop potatoes into ¼-inch pieces.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: In a medium bowl, combine beans, Tex-Mex paste, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Roughly mash beans with a potato masher or fork until about half are mashed.Stir in potatoes.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, 30 seconds.Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Drizzle with 1 TBSP oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings); brush or rub to completely coat on both sides.Add a heaping ¼ cup filling to one side of each tortilla. Top filling with Mexican cheese blend. instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Carefully place flautas, seam sides down, in air fryer. Air-fry until golden brown and crispy, 6-8 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, dice tomatoes into ¼-inch pieces. Quarter limes.In a small bowl (medium bowl for 4 servings), combine tomatoes, juice from half the limes, a pinch of salt, and pepper. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Divide flautas between plates and top with sour cream and salsa (draining first). Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side. TIP: If you have any remaining filling, add a drizzle of olive oil and microwave until warm, 30-60 seconds. Serve flautas over filling.

Wash and dry produce. • Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion; mince a few slices until you have 1 TBSP (2 TBSP for 4 servings). Quarter lime.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: • Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sliced onion; cook for 3 minutes. • Add beef and Southwest Spice Blend; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until beef is browned and onion is softened, 4-6 minutes. • Stir in Tex-Mex paste and 1⁄3 cup water (1⁄2 cup for 4 servings). Simmer until mixture has thickened and beef is cooked through, 2-4 minutes more. Turn off heat.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: • Meanwhile, drizzle tortillas with 1 TBSP olive oil (2 TBSP for 4 servings); brush or rub to completely coat both sides. • Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Once beef filling is done, add a heaping 1⁄4 cup filling to one side of each tortilla, then sprinkle each with 1 TBSP Mexican cheese blend. • Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create flautas. Place, seam sides down, on prepared sheet. TIP: Make sure the flautas are snug on the sheet—this will prevent them from unrolling. • Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crispy, 8-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: • While flautas bake, finely dice tomato and mince onion. In a small bowl, combine tomato, minced onion and a squeeze of lime juice. Season with salt. • Divide flautas between plates. Top with pico de gallo and red pepper crema. Serve with remaining lime wedges. Ground Poultry is fully cooked when internal temperature reaches 165°.

title: Vegetarian Cheesy Tofu Taquitos
subtitle: with Mexican Esquites-Style Corn

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Adjust rack to middle position and preheat oven to 425 degrees. Line a baking sheet with foil and coat with nonstick cooking spray. Wash and dry produce. Halve, peel, and finely chop onion. Thinly slice scallions. Quarter lime.Open and drain tofu; press out excess water with paper towels.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion and crumble tofu into small pieces directly into pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu and onion are lightly browned, 3-4 minutes. (If pan seems dry, add another drizzle of oil.) Add Fajita Spice Blend, salt, and pepper; stir until mixture is evenly coated. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is tender, 2-3 minutes more. Taste and season with more salt and pepper.Turn off heat; transfer tofu mixture to a medium bowl. Wipe out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, drizzle tortillas with oil; brush or rub to coat. Place on a clean work surface.Once filling is done, add a heaping ¼-cup scoop to one side of each tortilla; sprinkle with Mexican cheese blend. Roll up tortillas, starting with filled sides, to create taquitos. Place, seam sides down, on prepared baking sheet. TIP: Make sure the taquitos are snug on the sheet—this will prevent them from unrollingBake on middle rack until golden brown and crispy, 8-12 minutes.Bake on middle rack until golden brown and crispy, 8-12 minutes.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: While taquitos bake, drain corn; pat very dry with paper towels.Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for tofu over medium-high heat. Add corn and a big pinch of sugar; cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly charred, 4-6 minutes. TIP: Cover pan if corn begins to pop.Turn off heat; transfer corn to a second medium bowl.Turn off heat; transfer corn to a second medium bowl.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: To bowl with corn, stir in scallions, mayonnaise, sour cream, feta, juice from half the lime, salt, pepper, and as much chili powder as you like. Transfer to freezer to quickly cool. TIP: Low on freezer space? Transfer esquites to a shallow bowl, spread out, then refrigerate for quick cooling!

instructions_json.title: Divide taquitos between plates
instructions_json.body: Divide taquitos between plates. Top with esquites and serve with any remaining lime wedges on the side.

title: Fried Cheesy Organic Chicken Taquitos
subtitle: with Salsa, Cotija Cheese & Southwest Salad

instructions_json.title: Step 1
instructions_json.body: Pat chicken* dry with paper towels and season all over with half the Fajita Spice Blend (you’ll use the rest later), salt, and pepper.Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 5-6 minutes per side. TIP: If chicken is browning too quickly, reduce heat and cover with lid.Turn off heat; transfer chicken to a medium bowl. Wash and thoroughly dry pan (you’ll use it again in Step 5).

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce.Trim and discard root end from lettuce; chop leaves into bite-size pieces. Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces. Using your fingers, finely break up cotija cheese in package into crumbles.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Using two forks, shred chicken into bite-size pieces (if there is remaining liquid in bowl, stir chicken until absorbed).Stir in Mexican cheese blend and remaining Fajita Spice Blend until thoroughly combined.

instructions_json.title: Place tortillas on a clean work surface
instructions_json.body: Place tortillas on a clean work surface. Using a fork, poke a few holes in each tortilla.Divide shredded chicken filling between one half of each tortilla. Tightly roll tortillas and place seam sides down. TIP: Secure taquitos with toothpicks if you have them!

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Heat a ⅓-inch layer of oil in same pan used for chicken over medium-high heat. Once oil is hot, working one at a time with tongs, add taquitos, seam sides down, gently pressing for a few seconds to help ensure taquitos stay rolled (no need to press if using toothpicks!).Fry taquitos, working in batches if necessary and turning occasionally, until browned and crispy all over, 1-3 minutes.Remove taquitos from pan, allowing excess oil to drip off; place on a paper-towel-lined plate. Repeat with remaining taquitos. (If using toothpicks, remove after frying.)

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry bowl used to shred chicken
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry bowl used to shred chicken. Add lettuce, tomato, dressing, salt, and pepper; toss until evenly dressed.Divide taquitos and salad between plates. Top taquitos with salsa, sour cream, and cotija cheese and serve.

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry all produce
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry all produce. Halve and peel shallot; thinly slice half the shallot and mince remaining. Fill a small bowl with cold water; add sliced shallot and let soak. (TIP: This helps mellow its sharp bite.) Quarter tomatoes. Trim and dice cucumber. Zest and quarter lemon (quarter both lemons for 4 servings). Pick and finely chop fronds from dill.

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Drain sliced shallot and place in a medium bowl. Toss with tomatoes, cucumber, juice from half the lemon, a drizzle of olive oil, and 1 TBSP dill (2 TBSP for 4). Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add minced shallot; cook until softened, 1-2 minutes. Add couscous and a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until toasted, 2-3 minutes. Add ¾ cup water (1½ cups for 4) and stock concentrate. Bring to a boil; cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until couscous is tender, 6-8 minutes. Drain any excess water, if necessary. Taste and season with salt and pepper. Keep covered off heat.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels; season all over with ½ tsp Za’atar Spice (1 tsp for 4 servings; we sent more), salt, and pepper. Heat a large drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. (TIP: Work in batches, if necessary.) Transfer chicken to a cutting board. When cool enough to handle, thinly slice crosswise.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: While chicken cooks, in a second small bowl, combine feta, sour cream, and lemon zest to taste; mash together with a fork. (TIP: If the feta is cold, massage in the bag first to soften.) Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. (It’s okay if the sauce isn’t completely smooth.)

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Spread hummus on one side of each serving bowl. Fluff couscous with a fork; divide between bowls next to hummus. Top couscous with chicken. Drain excess liquid from salad; arrange over hummus. Drizzle everything with feta sauce. Garnish with remaining dill if desired. Serve with remaining lemon wedges on the side.

title: Apricot Balsamic Glazed Pork Filet
subtitle: with Ginger Garlic Rice & Sesame Green Beans

instructions_json.title: Wash and dry produce (except green beans)
instructions_json.body: Wash and dry produce (except green beans).Peel and mince or grate ginger. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and mince or grate garlic. Halve, peel, and mince half the shallot (whole shallot for 4 servings).

instructions_json.title: Step 2
instructions_json.body: Melt 1 TBSP butter in a small pot over medium-high heat. Add ginger, scallion whites, and half the garlic (all for 4 servings); cook until softened, 1-2 minutes.Stir in rice, half the stock concentrate (you’ll use the rest later) and 1¼ cups water (2¼ cups for 4). Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-18 minutes.Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.

instructions_json.title: Step 3
instructions_json.body: Pat pork* dry with paper towels; season all over with salt, pepper, and 1 tsp Fry Seasoning (2 tsp for 4 servings; we sent more).Heat a large drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork; cook until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes per side. TIP: Lower heat if pork begins to brown too quickly.Turn off heat; transfer to a cutting board to rest. Wash out pan.

instructions_json.title: Step 4
instructions_json.body: Melt 1 TBSP butter in same pan over medium-high heat. Add minced shallot and cook until softened, 2-3 minutes.Stir in jam and vinegar; simmer until syrupy, 30-60 seconds.Stir in ¼ cup water (½ cup for 4 servings), remaining stock concentrate, and 1 tsp sugar (2 tsp for 4). Bring to a boil, then lower heat; simmer until thickened, 3-4 minutes.Remove from heat. Stir in 1 TBSP butter until melted. Season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 5
instructions_json.body: Pierce green bean bag with a fork; place bag on a plate. Microwave until tender, 1-2 minutes. TIP: No microwave? No problem! Steam beans in a small pot with a splash of water until just tender, 5-7 minutes.Carefully transfer green beans to a medium bowl. Toss with sesame oil and season with salt and pepper.

instructions_json.title: Step 6
instructions_json.body: Fluff rice with a fork; season with salt and pepper. Stir any resting juices from pork into pan with glaze.Slice pork crosswise.Divide rice, pork, and green beans between plates. Drizzle pork with glaze. Top everything with scallion greens and soy sauce to taste. Serve.

appliance_override.rice_cooker: Rice Cooker Adaptation: Combine rinsed grains, water, and a pinch of salt in the Rice Cooker. Run the standard cycle, then fluff and fold in butter/seasonings before serving.
